chunks: Fuḍayl narrated from Zurārah from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
Choose healthy wet nurses, for milk transmits.

key_terms.الظُّئُورَةِ: wet-nursing or the state of being a wet nurse
key_terms.اللَّبَنَ: milk, specifically breast milk in this context
key_terms.الْوُضَّاءِ: sound, healthy, and pleasing in condition
key_terms.يُعْدِي: transmits or conveys effects from one to another

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام teach about choosing a wet nurse?
ai.summary: This hadith instructs care in selecting wet nurses, recommending those who are sound and healthy. It emphasizes that milk has effects that can be passed on, highlighting concern for the child’s well-being in breastfeeding.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4677 - Fudayl narrated from Zurarah from Abu Ja'far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) who said:
"Choose healthy wet nurses, for milk can transmit illness."
